divergences.octaneResult: Target options use a plain { current: EventTarget | null } object.
divergences.rationale: Octane has no React.RefObject type, while the runtime ref shape is framework-neutral.
divergences.consumerImpact: Consumers type target refs as plain current-bearing objects.
divergences.migrationGuidance: Pass the same current-bearing ref object without importing React ref types.
divergences.reviewCondition: Review if Octane introduces a canonical RefObject type.
